battle.name: 顏宣政起義
battle.brief: 隋煬帝大業十一年（615）正月戊戌日，齊郡賊帥顏宣政聚眾起事，隋廷遣武賁郎將高建毗於齊郡破之，虜男女數千口。卡面為前七世紀希臘科林斯青銅盔，與此役相隔一千二百餘年，未曾出現在東亞戰場，僅作跨時代對照。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場衝突是隋朝中央與齊郡鄉里聚眾之間的一場鎮壓戰，交戰雙方規模都很小，卻折射出隋末的結構性問題。叛方是齊郡（隋代治歷城縣，即今山東濟南一帶）的鄉里百姓，首領為《隋書》本紀所稱的「賊帥顏宣政」；他們沒有常設編制，沒有可考的軍號與官爵，靠里社鄰里間的招呼迅速聚合，以屯聚鄉野、威脅縣城為主要手段，兵器多為自帶的農具與竹木杆兵。官軍一方是隋朝在齊郡及鄰郡的鎮壓部隊：由郡府與州縣調集的郡兵、縣兵為主，配少量州級將校直轄的宿衛兵骨幹，主將為武賁郎將高建毗。命令來自當月正在東都洛陽大宴百僚的隋煬帝：正月甲午朔朝會、正月戊戌齊郡事平，兩個月後的三月壬子，煬帝才御駕涿郡再啟新一輪征高句麗。郡內的實際防務則由齊郡與鄰郡的長吏、縣令分頭承擔。值得注意的是，隋廷在遼東用兵正酣，能投入山東的中央精兵有限，鎮壓叛亂主要依靠地方郡兵；而這批郡兵裝備陳舊、訓練鬆散，多屬臨時徵發的鄉兵，遠非徵發高句麗時的精銳。
countriesEn: This was a suppression fight between the Sui central government and a rural rising in the commandery of Qi, small in scale on both sides yet revealing the structural weakness of the late Sui. On the rebel side were the villagers of Qi commandery — governed in Sui times from Licheng county, in today's Jinan, Shandong — led by the man the annals of the Book of Sui call the rebel commander Yan Xuanzheng. They had no standing establishment, no recorded unit titles and no official ranks, and they came together quickly through neighbourhood networks, relying on holding the countryside and threatening county seats; their weapons were largely farming tools and wooden or bamboo pole weapons carried in by the men themselves. On the government side stood the Sui force raised in Qi and the neighbouring commanderies: mostly commandery and county levies mustered by the local administration, with a small core of imperial guards under a commandery-level general, the command in the hands of Gao Jianpi, commander of the Wu-bi Lang-jiang. The order came from Emperor Yang of Sui, who was in that very month feasting the court at the eastern capital of Luoyang: the great audience fell on the first day of the first month, the affair in Qi was settled on the fifth, and only two months later, in the third month, did the emperor ride out to Zhuojun to launch a fresh campaign against Goguryeo. The actual defence of the district fell to the senior officials and magistrates of Qi and its neighbours. It is worth noting that with the bulk of the Sui army committed in Liaodong, only a limited number of central troops could be spared for Shandong, so suppression was entrusted to local levies — poorly equipped, loosely trained and largely conscripted villagers, nothing like the elite troops raised for the Goguryeo campaigns.
people: 史籍對顏宣政的記載極少，能確定的只有兩點：他籍貫齊郡，是大業十一年正月被平定的起義首領；事後他本人下落不明，無論生擒或陣亡，均未見記載。《隋書·煬帝紀》大業十一年正月只留一句：「戊戌，武賁郎將高建毗破賊帥顏宣政於齊郡，虜男女數千口。」《隋書》與《資治通鑑》都沒有留下陣亡名單、官軍兵數或任何損耗數，齊郡的郡守、刺史與歷城等縣的縣令姓名同樣缺名，只能確認郡兵奉調集結、聚眾被壓散。放在更長的時段裏看，這場起義正落在隋煬帝兩次征高句麗皆無功而返、大業十一年三月又再御駕涿郡的當口，山東河北的徵發從未停歇；前此已有山東長白山的王薄首義，隋廷懸賞購求、搜捕牽連山東各郡。前線名將張須陀當時正在河北清剿流民群，其後一年正月戰死於河間盧家塞，此後更無可靠大將可以調回山東收拾殘局。
peopleEn: The records about Yan Xuanzheng are extremely thin, and only two points can be stated with certainty: that he was a native of Qi commandery and the leader of the rising that was put down in the first month of the eleventh year of Daye; and that his fate afterwards is unknown, with no record of his being taken alive or killed in the fighting, and no later mention of him in any biography. The Book of Sui, in the annals of the eleventh year of Daye, preserves a single sentence: on the wu-xu day, Gao Jianpi, commander of the Wu-bi Lang-jiang, broke the rebel commander Yan Xuanzheng in Qi commandery and took several thousand men and women prisoner. Neither that work nor the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance leaves a casualty list, a figure for the government force or any measure of losses, and the names of Qi's commandery governor and inspector and of the magistrates of Licheng and the other counties are likewise missing; all that can be confirmed is that the levies were mustered and the gathering broken up. On the wider stage the rising falls in the gap between two Sui campaigns against Goguryeo that both ended in failure, with a third campaign already being prepared in the eleventh year of Daye; the levies on Hebei and Shandong were never allowed to rest, and earlier Wang Bo had risen at Changbaishan in Shandong, for whose capture the court had posted rewards, the manhunt reaching into many households of the commandery. The famous general Zhang Xutuo was at that moment grinding up refugee bands in Hebei and was killed the following year, in the first month, at Lujiasei in the neighbourhood of Hejian; no dependable general was left to be recalled to Shandong afterwards.
kits: 卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔是前七世紀希臘的產物：全正面開眼、只留一道狹窄視縫觀敵的青銅頭盔，設計前提是密集方陣中的正面搏鬥，戴盔者靠整排頭盔的視線縫保持陣形一致。它與隋朝山東鄉里之間的戰爭沒有任何裝備上的關係，也不能出現在 615 年的戰場上：兩者相隔約一千二百六十年，歐亞東西兩端的冶金、護具與兵制發展路徑並無交集。卡面在此只是本站用來對照「以整齊頭盔維持方陣」這一軍事原理的跨時代標本。真正上陣的是隋軍的常備武備：護身以皮甲、札甲為主，明光鎧一類鐵鎧多配給騎兵與軍官，頭戴兜鍪（兩耳下垂護頸、披膊護肩），作戰用橫刀、環首刀、長槊與方天戟，弓以角弓、竹木弓為主，弩有臂弩、蹶張弩與常平弩等數種，重型弩機列於軍陣之後，攻城另備投石機、巢車、撞車與雲梯，輜重依靠牛車與馬匹輸送，帳幕鼓角旌旗齊整。叛方沒有制式裝備，靠的是木杆矛、竹槍、繩索、鐮斧與農具，護身只有皮甲或布衣，靠人數、齊整與地勢取勝，糧食則多取自里正供送的存糧。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is a seventh-century BCE Greek product: a bronze helmet closed over the whole face with only a narrow viewing slit, designed for close fighting in a dense phalanx, the wearer keeping the line in step through the aligned sight-slots of the rank. It has no equipment relationship whatsoever to the war between Sui and the villagers of Shandong and could not have been present on a battlefield in 615: the two are separated by roughly twelve hundred and sixty years, and the metallurgical, armouring and military-organisational paths of the two ends of Eurasia never intersected. The card is used here simply as a cross-era reference for the military principle of holding a formation in line through uniform helmets. What actually went into battle were the standard Sui arms: protection was mainly leather and lamellar armour, with iron plate of the bright-light type given mostly to cavalry and officers; troops wore caps with side flaps protecting the neck together with shoulder guards; the cutting and thrusting weapons were the hengdao cross-sabre, the ring-pommel sabre, the long spear and the fangtian halberd; bows were of horn or wood and bamboo, and crossbows came in several types including the single-handed, the drawn and the repeated-cocking heavy crossbow, the powerful crossbow engines being deployed behind the main line; for siege work the Sui brought stone-throwers, siege towers, battering rams and scaling ladders, and supplies moved by ox-carts and pack horses, with tents, drums, horns and banners all in good order. The rebels had no regulation equipment: wooden-shafted spears, bamboo lances, ropes, sickles, axes and farm tools, with only leather armour or homespun cloth for protection, winning on numbers, rough order and ground, and drawing their grain from the stores collected by the village headmen.
tactics: 《隋書》本紀對本役交戰經過一字未記，只留下「破賊帥顏宣政於齊郡」一句，因此具體部署只能作背景參照：以下是隋末山東鄉里起義的一般形態，並非本役的實錄。叛方通常先在鄉里聚眾，人數不足以攻城時便屯聚於山林、陂澤與村落之間的隱蔽地帶，等待官軍離開或分散時再襲擊縣城、驅散糧車；逼近郡治時以柴草堆塞門戶、穴地掘進、攀城而入，破城之後往往一掠而散，重新散入鄉野。齊郡北接濟水、南倚泰山餘脈，河流縱橫、澤地連片，郡北的濟北一帶又夾在齊郡與渤海郡之間，道路多為田間小徑，大隊騎兵難以展開，這是聚眾得以周旋的地理條件。官軍的處置則是典型的郡兵鎮壓：由郡府與各縣集結步卒為主力，前列布弩，槊手與射手在後，騎兵分置兩翼，主要任務不是攻殺而是包圍、驅散、追捕潰卒，最後以清剿殘部、押解俘虜收尾。高建毗的戰果記作「虜男女數千口」，即大量人眾被成建制地捉回，說明官軍的部署以封鎖聚落、驅趕人眾入陣地為主。整場戰事的成敗關鍵不在單挑，而在能否把鬆散聚眾在同一時間壓在一處。
tacticsEn: The annals of the Book of Sui record not one word of how the fighting was conducted, preserving only the phrase that the rebel commander Yan Xuanzheng was broken in Qi commandery, so the deployment can only be given as background: what follows is the general shape of village risings in late-Sui Shandong, not a record of this action. Such crowds would first gather in the villages; while their numbers were too small to take a walled town they would hold out in the wooded hills, the marshes and the hidden ground between settlements, waiting for the government troops to move off or to scatter before striking at the county towns and driving off the grain carts; when they closed on the commandery seat they piled brushwood against the gates, tunnelled under the walls and climbed in, and after a city fell they would plunder and scatter again, dispersing back into the countryside. Qi commandery ran from the Ji River in the north to the spurs of Mount Tai in the south, with braided waterways and wide stretches of marsh, and the northern district lay wedged between Qi and Bohai commanderies, where the roads were mostly field paths on which large bodies of cavalry could not operate — that was the ground on which such crowds were able to move. The government's response was the standard suppression by commandery levies: infantry mustered by the commandery office and the counties formed the core, crossbows deployed in front, spear and bow men behind them, cavalry posted on the two wings, the main task being not to kill but to encircle, to break up and to run down those who fled, the business then closing with the mopping up of stragglers and the escorting of prisoners. Gao Jianpi's result is recorded as several thousand men and women taken prisoner, that is, large numbers of people driven back in bodies, which suggests that the government deployment aimed at sealing the settlements and pushing the crowd into a single field. The whole business turned on a single point, not on single combat but on whether the loose crowds could be compressed into one place at one time.
data: 可核對的數字不多，逐一列明：日期為隋大業十一年正月戊戌日——該月朔日甲午，自朔推得戊戌為正月初五，即公元 615 年年初；本紀原文作「戊戌，武賁郎將高建毗破賊帥顏宣政於齊郡，虜男女數千口」。參戰官軍的兵員數史無明載，僅知為武賁郎將高建毗所率的郡兵與縣兵，規模屬郡級；叛眾人數史書不載確數，只能由「虜男女數千口」推知被捉回者以數千計。地理數據方面，齊郡治歷城縣，即今山東濟南，郡境領歷城、盂山、章丘、淄川、長山等縣；自歷城至京師洛陽約三百五十公里上下，軍報須循濟水、清水轉入河洛道。作為同年同類亂事量級的對照（《隋書·煬帝紀》大業十一年）：二月賊帥揚仲緒率眾萬餘攻北平、滑公李景破斬之；同月上谷人王須拔反、自稱漫天王、國號燕，賊帥魏刁兒自稱歷山飛，眾各十餘萬；七月淮南人張起緒聚眾三萬；十月彭城人魏騏驎聚眾萬餘、賊帥盧明月聚眾十餘萬，東海賊帥李子通渡淮自號楚王；十一月賊帥王須拔破高陽郡；十二月譙郡人朱粲擁眾數十萬、僭稱楚帝。這些數字屬同年亂事的量級，與齊郡一場郡級聚眾不可混用。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and they are set out one by one. The date is the wu-xu day of the first month of the eleventh year of Daye: the first day of that month was jia-wu, from which wu-xu falls on the fifth, that is in early 615. The annals read: on the wu-xu day, Gao Jianpi, commander of the Wu-bi Lang-jiang, broke the rebel commander Yan Xuanzheng in Qi commandery and took several thousand men and women prisoner. The number of government troops is nowhere recorded; all that is known is that they were the commandery and county levies under Gao Jianpi, a force of commandery scale. The size of the rebel crowd is not given and can only be inferred from the several thousand prisoners taken. On geography: the seat of Qi commandery was Licheng county, in today's Jinan, Shandong, and the commandery held the counties of Licheng, Yushan, Zhangqiu, Zichuan and Changshan; from Licheng to the capital at Luoyang is about three hundred and fifty kilometres, and dispatches would have to travel up the Ji and the Qingshui into the Heluo road. For comparison, the scale of comparable disturbances in the same year, from the annals of the eleventh year of Daye in the Book of Sui: in the second month the rebel commander Yang Zhongxu led more than ten thousand men against Beiping and was cut down by the Duke of Hua, Li Jing; in the same month a man of Shanggu named Wang Xuba rebelled, styled himself Prince of Man and gave the state the name of Yan, while the rebel commander Wei Diaoer styled himself Fei of Lishan, each with more than a hundred thousand men; in the seventh month a man of Huainan named Zhang Qixu gathered thirty thousand; in the tenth month a man of Pengcheng named Wei Qilin gathered more than ten thousand men to rob Lu commandery, the rebel commander Lu Mingyue gathered more than a hundred thousand, and the rebel commander Li Zitong of the Eastern Sea crossed the Huai, styled himself King of Chu and raided Jiangdu; in the eleventh month the rebel commander Wang Xuba took the commandery seat of Gaoyang; in the twelfth month a man of Qiao named Zhu Can had several hundred thousand men, invaded Jing and Xiang and usurped the title of Emperor of Chu. These are the magnitudes of the year's disturbances and must not be mixed up with a single commandery-level rising in Qi.
cause: 起義的直接誘因，史料沒有留下直接記載，只能從時局推斷。大業十年（614）三月隋煬帝再御駕涿郡攻高句麗，八月班師而前功盡棄；大業十一年正月他仍在東都洛陽朝會，卻已著手再整軍備，三月壬子第三次御駕涿郡。兩次無功的東征之間，兵役、漕運與徭役同時加到北方各州縣；齊郡是山東重要的租調與丁役輸出地，郡縣官吏為完足額數而催科急迫，鄉里承受力已到極限。此前山東長白山的王薄首義被隋廷懸賞緝拿，搜捕牽連郡內多家，人心浮動；大業十年鄰近州郡已接連出現扶風唐弼眾十萬、彭城張大彪眾數萬等大聚眾案，同類的武裝反抗在鄉里已有現成榜樣。與此同時，山東鄉里對「郡兵遠征、地方空虛」有直接感受，聚眾自保式的反抗因此容易成形。值得注意的是，這一帶在隋末此後數年確實接連出現更大規模的叛亂：河間竇建德、淮南杜伏威、太原劉武周、遼東宇文化及相繼而起。顏宣政本人此前的經歷、是否曾任吏或受過官府徵發，史料未載，其角色更接近地方起義的最初發動者，而非逐級擴大的舊軍將領。
causeEn: The immediate trigger of the rising is not recorded in the sources and can only be inferred from the situation. In the third month of the tenth year of Daye (614) Emperor Yang set out for Zhuojun once more against Goguryeo and returned in the eighth month with the campaign a failure; in the first month of the eleventh year he was still holding court at the eastern capital of Luoyang, yet he was already preparing another host, and in the third month he rode to Zhuojun for a third time. Between two fruitless eastern campaigns the burden of military service, river transport and corvée labour fell on the northern provinces and commanderies. Qi was an important source of grain tax and labour for Shandong, and the commandery and county officials, scrambling to make up the full quota, pressed the villages until the limit of what they could bear was reached. Earlier, Wang Bo's rising at Changbaishan in Shandong had been answered with posted rewards and a manhunt that reached into many households of the commandery, leaving the population unsettled; in the tenth year of Daye large gatherings had already appeared in the neighbouring prefectures, with a hundred thousand men under the Tang prince Li Hong and tens of thousands under Zhang Diaobiao, so that armed resistance already had a ready model in the villages. At the same time the villages of Shandong could see for themselves that the commandery levies were far away and the districts empty, and a rising of the self-defence kind was therefore easy to form. It is worth noticing that in the following years of the late Sui the same region did see larger rebellions in succession: Dou Jiande in Hebei, Du Fuwei in the Huai valley, Liu Wuzhou at Taiyuan and Yuwen Huaji in Liaodong. Nothing is known of Yan Xuanzheng's earlier life, of whether he had ever held office or been called up by the authorities; his role looks more like that of the first man to set a local rising going than that of a former officer building on an existing force.
impact: 這場起義在軍事上是一場速戰速決的鎮壓：聚眾很快被壓散，齊郡的郡級秩序在短期內恢復，隋朝中央在山東的威信沒有受到致命打擊。但放在隋末的長時段裏看，這一役有兩層意義。第一，暴露了中央對山東河北的控制已高度依賴地方：能拿下叛亂的只有郡兵與縣兵，這批人既是鎮壓者，也是下一次徵兵時的來源，國家機器與地方武力的界線在起義與反起義的循環中被磨薄。第二，延續了山東自王薄以來的地方武裝傳統，把「以郡兵平地方叛亂」的常態化成本轉嫁給河北山東的郡縣，此後數年山東、河北諸郡的郡兵屢徵屢疲，鄉里青壯大批脫離戶籍與田畝，軍隊與賦役的基礎同時受損。史書沒有記載顏宣政本人之後的結局，這場起義也因而成為一段沒有延續的政治實體；但它在時間上正好卡在隋朝崩潰之前的最後幾年，成為觀察隋末亂序如何在郡縣層面醞釀的一段切口。
impactEn: Militarily the rising was a quick suppression: the crowd was broken up within a short time, the commandery-level order in Qi was restored, and the authority of the Sui centre in Shandong did not suffer a mortal blow. Placed in the longer span of the late Sui, however, the episode carries two meanings. First, it shows how far central control over Shandong and Hebei had come to depend on the localities: the only troops able to end the rising were the commandery and county levies, and the same men who suppressed it were also the pool from which the next levy would be drawn, so that the boundary between the state apparatus and local military power was rubbed thin by the cycle of revolt and repression. Second, it carried on the armed tradition of local self-defence in Shandong that had begun with Wang Bo, and it made the routine cost of putting down provincial rebellions with provincial troops a permanent charge on the commanderies of Hebei and Shandong; for years afterwards the levies of the commanderies of Shandong and Hebei were raised and exhausted repeatedly, the young men of the villages fell away in large numbers from the registers and the fields, and the base of both the army and the taxation was damaged at once. The histories do not record what became of Yan Xuanzheng himself, and for that reason this rising left no political entity behind it. Placed where it falls in time, immediately before the last few years of the Sui collapse, it remains a useful point of entry for watching how disorder in the late Sui was brewed at the level of the commandery and the county.
result: 結果是起義失敗。顏宣政所聚的叛眾被武賁郎將高建毗率軍擊破，《隋書·煬帝紀》記「破賊帥顏宣政於齊郡，虜男女數千口」，聚眾星散，潰散之眾遭追捕搜剿，戰後官府以「虜男女數千口」作為結案數字；齊郡的縣城與郡治未失陷於叛方之手，郡兵在年內恢復對郡境的控制。顏宣政本人的去向史無明載，沒有記載他被生擒、陣亡或流亡，此後亦不見於任何傳記，此役遂以地方民變的普通案卷結案。從全局看，這次鎮壓成功並不等於隋朝恢復穩態：次年（616）河北竇建德起兵，617 年劉武周取太原、杜伏威在淮南起事、李子通渡淮自號楚王，617 年底宇文化及攻破潼關，隋煬帝於 618 年在江都遇弒，隋朝自 581 年建國到 618 年亡國的三十七年間在起義潮中迅速收束。若單看本役，它是一次乾淨的郡級平叛；若放進 615 至 618 這條線索裏，它標示著隋朝在地方上仍能收復局面，卻已無力再重建一套能約束所有郡縣的秩序。
resultEn: The rising failed. The crowd led by Yan Xuanzheng was broken by the troops under Gao Jianpi, Wu-bi Lang-jiang; the Book of Sui records that he broke the rebel commander Yan Xuanzheng in Qi commandery and took several thousand men and women prisoner. The gathering scattered, those who fled were hunted down and searched for, and that capture is the official record of the outcome; the county towns and the commandery seat of Qi were not taken by the rebels, and the commandery levies regained control of the district within the year. Yan Xuanzheng's own fate is not recorded: nothing says whether he was taken alive, killed in the fighting or gone into hiding, and he is not mentioned again in any biography, so the affair was closed as an ordinary case of local revolt. In the wider view, a successful suppression did not amount to a restoration of stability: the next year, 616, Dou Jiande rose in Hebei; in 617 Liu Wuzhou took Taiyuan, Du Fuwei rose in the Huai valley and Li Zitong crossed the Huai styling himself King of Chu; at the end of that year Yuwen Huaji broke through Tong Pass, and Emperor Yang was killed at Jiangdu in 618, so that the thirty-seven years from the founding of the Sui in 581 to its end in 618 contracted rapidly in the tide of rebellion. Judged on its own, this was a clean commandery-level suppression; set into the line running from 615 to 618, it marks a Sui that could still recover a situation locally but could no longer rebuild an order binding every commandery and county.
